opening_story.ha:
Gane Tonye.

Tonye yana da shekaru 21, daga Yenagoa. Shi ne mutum mafi daraja a cikin kungiyar abokansa. Lokacin da ya yi magana, kowa yana sauraro.

Wata daren, matasan suna shan giya kuma daya daga cikinsu ya fara magana game da wata yarinya a cikin kalmomi masu zagi. Kowa yana dariya. Tattaunawar ta karu.

Tonye ma yana dariya — a farko.

Amma daga bisani ya tuno da kanwarsa mai shekaru 16. Kuma yana tunanin wani yana magana a kan ta haka.

Ya daina dariya. Ya ce: "Don Allah, wannan kanwar wani ne. Mu canza batun."

Akwai wani lokacin shiru. Sai wani ya ce: "Ka yi hakuri. Na yi kuskure." Tattaunawar ta canza.

Tonye ba ya bayar da jawabi. Bai yi ihu ba. Ya yi amfani da tasirin da ya riga ya samu — kuma ya yi aiki.
opening_story.yo:
Pẹ̀lú Tonye.

Tonye jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 21, láti Yenagoa. Ó jẹ́ ẹni tó ní ìbáṣepọ̀ jùlọ nínú ẹgbẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ. Nígbà tí ó bá sọ̀rọ̀, gbogbo ènìyàn ń tẹ́tí sí.

Ní alẹ́ kan, àwọn ọkùnrin ń mu ọtí, ẹnìkan bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í sọ̀rọ̀ nípa obìnrin kan pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó ní ìbànújẹ. Gbogbo ènìyàn ń rẹ́rìn-ín. Ìjíròrò náà ń pọ̀ si.

Tonye náà ń rẹ́rìn-ín pẹ̀lú — ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀.

Ṣùgbọ́n nígbà tí ó ròyìn ìyàwó rẹ tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 16. Ó sì ń foju inú rẹ wo ẹni tó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa rẹ bẹ́ẹ̀.

Ó dá a duro láti rẹ́rìn-ín. Ó sọ pé: "Jọ̀ọ́, èyí jẹ́ ìyàwó ẹlòmíràn. Ẹ jẹ́ ká yí ìtàn padà."

Ó ní ìgbà díẹ̀ ti ìdákẹ́jẹ. Lẹ́yìn náà, ẹlòmíràn sọ pé: "O dáa. Kò dáa fún mi." Ìjíròrò náà yípadà.

Tonye kò fi ẹ̀sùn kàn. Kò kó ìkà. Ó kan lo ìtàn tó ti ní — ó sì ṣiṣẹ́.
opening_story.ig:
Nụ Tonye.

Tonye bụ afọ 21, si Yenagoa. Ọ bụ onye a na-asọpụrụ n'òtù ndị enyi ya. Mgbe ọ na-ekwu, onye ọ bụla na-ege ntị.

N'abalị otu, ụmụ nwoke na-aṅụ mmanya, otu n'ime ha malitere ikwu banyere nwaanyị n'okwu na-adịghị mma. Onye ọ bụla na-eme ọchị. Mkparịta ụka ahụ na-arị elu.

Tonye na-eme ọchị kwa — n'ibido.

Ma mgbe ahụ, o chetara nwanne ya nwanyị nke afọ 16. O chepụtara na mmadụ na-ekwu banyere ya n'ụzọ a.

O kwụsịrị ịchị ọchị. O sịrị: "Biko, nke a bụ nwanne onye. Ka anyị gbanwee isiokwu."

E nwere otu oge nkwụsị. Mgbe ahụ, onye ọzọ sịrị: "I ziri ezi. M na-emehie." Mkparịta ụka ahụ gbanwere.

Tonye anaghị enye okwu. Ọ naghị ekwu. Ọ jiri mmetụta ọ nwere — ma ọ rụrụ ọrụ.

content.en:
Every man has influence — over his friends, his siblings, his colleagues, his community.

Influence is not reserved for pastors, politicians, or people with large followings. Influence is in everyday moments: The joke you laugh at or refuse to laugh at. The comment you make or stay silent about. The story you share on social media. The way you treat women in front of other men.

You are already shaping the men around you. The question is: what are you shaping them into?
content.pcm:
Every man get influence — over him friends, him siblings, him colleagues, him community.

Influence no dey reserved for pastors, politicians, or people wey get large followings. Influence dey for everyday moments: Di joke wey you dey laugh at or wey you refuse to laugh at. Di comment wey you make or wey you dey silent about. Di story wey you dey share for social media. Di way wey you dey treat women for front of other men.

You don dey shape di men around you. Di question be: wetin you dey shape dem into?
content.ha:
Kowane namiji yana da tasiri — akan abokansa, 'yan'uwansa, abokan aikinsa, al'ummarsa.

Tasiri ba ya kasance ga fastoci, 'yan siyasa, ko mutane masu yawan mabiyansu. Tasiri yana cikin lokuta na yau da kullum: Wani dariya da kake yi ko ka ki yi dariya. Sharhin da kake yi ko ka yi shiru akai. Labarin da kake raba a shafukan sada zumunta. Hanyar da kake mu'amala da mata a gaban sauran maza.

Kana riga kana tsara mazan da ke kewaye da kai. Tambayar ita ce: me kake tsara su zuwa?
content.yo:
Gbogbo ọkùnrin ní ìtàn — lórí àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ, àwọn ará rẹ, àwọn ẹlẹ́gbẹ́ rẹ, àti àwùjọ rẹ.

Ìtàn kì í jẹ́ ti àwọn pastor, àwọn olóṣèlú, tàbí àwọn ènìyàn tó ní àwùjọ tó pọ̀. Ìtàn wà nínú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ojoojúmọ́: Ìtàn tí o rẹ́rìn-ín sí tàbí tí o kọ́ láti rẹ́rìn-ín. Àwọn àlàyé tí o sọ tàbí tí o dára sí. Ìtàn tí o pin lórí àwọn ìkànnì àwùjọ. Bóyá o ṣe obìnrin ní iwájú àwọn ọkùnrin míì.

O ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í ṣe àtúnṣe àwọn ọkùnrin tó wà ní àyíká rẹ. Ìbéèrè ni: kí ni o fẹ́ ṣe wọn sí?
content.ig:
Nwoke ọ bụla nwere mmetụta — n'elu ndị enyi ya, ụmụnne ya, ndị ọrụ ibe ya, na obodo ya.

Mmetụta abụghị naanị maka ndị ụkọchukwu, ndị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere ọtụtụ ndị na-eso. Mmetụta dị na oge kwa ụbọchị: N'ịchị ọchị ma ọ bụ ịjụ ịchị ọchị. Okwu ị na-ekwu ma ọ bụ ị na-ezobe. Akụkọ ị na-ekekọrịta na mgbasa ozi. Otu ị si emeso ụmụ nwanyị n'ihu ndị ọzọ.

I nwere ike ịmepụta ndị nwoke nọ gburugburu gị. Ajụjụ bụ: gịnị ka ị na-emepụta ha ka ha bụrụ?

content.en:
The most powerful form of leadership is not what you say — it is what you do consistently.

You become a role model when: You speak respectfully about and to women — always. You call out harmful jokes, even at the cost of short-term comfort. You show emotional honesty among your peers. You ask for help when you need it. You take responsibility when you are wrong, without excuse.

People are watching. Your example gives others permission to be better.
content.pcm:
Di most powerful form of leadership no be wetin you dey talk — na wetin you dey do consistently.

You go become role model when: You dey speak respectfully about and to women — always. You dey call out harmful jokes, even if e go cost you short-term comfort. You dey show emotional honesty among your peers. You dey ask for help when you need am. You dey take responsibility when you dey wrong, without excuse.

People dey watch. Your example dey give others permission to be better.
content.ha:
Mafi karfin jagoranci ba shine abin da kake cewa ba — shine abin da kake yi akai-akai.

Kana zama misali lokacin da: Kana magana da girmamawa game da mata — koyaushe. Kana kiran dariya masu cutarwa, ko da hakan na iya jawo maka rashin jin dadi na dan lokaci. Kana nuna gaskiya a cikin ji tsakanin abokanka. Kana neman taimako lokacin da kake bukata. Kana daukar alhakin lokacin da kake kuskure, ba tare da uzuri ba.

Mutane suna kallo. Misalinka yana ba wa wasu izinin zama mafi kyau.
content.yo:
Ìmúra tó lágbára jùlọ ní àkóso kì í ṣe ohun tí o sọ — ṣùgbọ́n ohun tí o ṣe ní àkóso.

O di àpẹẹrẹ nígbà tí: O bá sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìbáṣepọ̀ nípa àti sí obìnrin — ní gbogbo àkókò. O ń pe àwọn àlàyé tó ní ìbànújẹ, koda bí ó ṣe le fa ìdààmú àkókò kékeré. O ń fi ìmọ̀lára hàn láàárín àwọn ẹlẹ́gbẹ́ rẹ. O ń béèrè fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ nígbà tí o bá nílò. O ń gba ojúṣe nígbà tí o bá jẹ́ aṣiṣe, láìsí àdúrà.

Àwọn ènìyàn ń wo. Àpẹẹrẹ rẹ ń fún àwọn mìíràn ní àṣẹ láti di ẹni tó dára.
content.ig:
Ụdị ndú kachasị ike abụghị ihe ị na-ekwu — kama, ihe ị na-eme mgbe niile.

Ị na-abụ ihe atụ mgbe: Ị na-ekwu n'ịhụnanya banyere na ụmụ nwanyị — mgbe niile. Ị na-akpọpụta ihe ọchị na-emebi, ọbụlagodi na ọ ga-emebi gị n'ọnọdụ dị mkpirikpi. Ị na-egosi eziokwu n'echiche gị n'etiti ndị enyi gị. Ị na-arịọ maka enyemaka mgbe ịchọrọ ya. Ị na-anabata ọrụ mgbe ị na-emehie, na-enweghị mgbaghara.

Ndị mmadụ na-elekọta. Ihe atụ gị na-enye ndị ọzọ ikike ka ha bụrụ ndị ka mma.

content.en:
Advocacy means speaking up for change — in your family, community, school, or workplace.

You don't need a microphone or a platform to be an advocate. Advocacy starts in small moments: Having honest conversations with your brothers, friends, and sons about GBV. Sharing accurate information on social media. Challenging leaders respectfully when they say harmful things. Mentoring younger men and boys in your community.

Every advocate was once a bystander who decided to act. This is your moment.
content.pcm:
Advocacy mean to dey speak up for change — for your family, community, school, or workplace.

You no need microphone or platform to be advocate. Advocacy dey start for small moments: Having honest conversations with your brothers, friends, and sons about GBV. Sharing correct information for social media. Challenging leaders respectfully when dem dey talk harmful things. Mentoring younger men and boys for your community.

Every advocate don once be bystander wey decide to act. Dis na your moment.
content.ha:
Mai kare hakkin jama'a yana nufin yin magana don canji — a cikin iyalinka, al'umma, makaranta, ko wurin aiki.

Ba ka bukatar makirufo ko dandamali don zama mai kare hakkin jama'a. Mai kare hakkin jama'a yana farawa daga kananan lokuta: Yin tattaunawa mai gaskiya tare da 'yan uwanka, abokanka, da 'ya'yanka game da GBV. Raba ingantaccen bayani a shafukan sada zumunta. Kalubalantar shugabanni da girmamawa lokacin da suke cewa abubuwan da ke cutarwa. Jagorantar matasa da yara a cikin al'ummarka.

Duk mai kare hakkin jama'a yana da wani lokaci a baya wanda ya yanke shawarar yin aiki. Wannan shine lokacin ka.
content.yo:
Olùdájọ́ túmọ̀ sí láti sọ̀rọ̀ fún àtúnṣe — nínú ìdílé rẹ, àwùjọ, ilé ẹ̀kọ́, tàbí ibi iṣẹ́.

O kò nílò makirufó tàbí pẹpẹ láti di olùdájọ́. Olùdájọ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kékeré: Nípa ṣiṣe ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú àwọn arákùnrin rẹ, àwọn ọ̀rẹ́, àti àwọn ọmọ rẹ nípa GBV. Pín ìmọ̀ tó péye lórí àwọn ìkànnì àwùjọ. Kálẹ̀ àwọn olórí pẹ̀lú ìbáṣepọ̀ nígbà tí wọ́n bá sọ̀rọ̀ tó ní ìbànújẹ. Kó àwọn ọkùnrin àti àwọn ọmọ kékeré nínú àwùjọ rẹ.

Gbogbo olùdájọ́ jẹ́ ẹnìkan tó jẹ́ olùdájọ́ tó pinnu láti ṣiṣẹ́. Èyí ni àkókò rẹ.
content.ig:
Nkwado pụtara ịsị okwu maka mgbanwe — n'ezinụlọ gị, obodo, ụlọ akwụkwọ, ma ọ bụ ebe ọrụ.

Ị chọghị igwe okwu ma ọ bụ ikpo okwu iji bụrụ onye nkwado. Nkwado na-amalite na oge ndị nta: Ị na-eme mkparịta ụka eziokwu na ụmụnne gị, ndị enyi, na ụmụ gị banyere GBV. Ị na-ekekọrịta ozi ziri ezi na mgbasa ozi. Ị na-eme ka ndị isi nwee nkwanye ugwu mgbe ha na-ekwu okwu na-emebi. Ị na-eduzi ụmụ nwoke na ụmụaka n'obodo gị.

Onye nkwado ọ bụla bụ onye na-anọghị na ya na kpebiri ime ihe. Nke a bụ oge gị.

opening_story.en:
Meet Segun.

Segun is 27. He lives in Ibadan. After completing a GBV training, he went back to his community and started a conversation — just him and five friends under a mango tree.

He shared what he had learned. He asked questions. He listened.

Within a month, the group grew to 30 men. They called themselves the "Ibadan Brothers' Circle."

They started holding weekly meetings. They began sharing information in WhatsApp groups. They organised a community dialogue.

One of their members stopped his friend from beating his wife. Another reported a case of child marriage to the authorities.

Segun didn't have money. He didn't have a title. He had knowledge, commitment, and community. That was enough.

E share wetin e learn. E ask questions. E dey listen.

Within one month, the group grow to 30 men. Dem call demself "Ibadan Brothers' Circle."

Dem start to dey hold weekly meetings. Dem begin to dey share information for WhatsApp groups. Dem organise community dialogue.

One of their members stop him friend from beating him wife. Another one report case of child marriage to the authorities.

Segun no get money. E no get title. Wetin e get na knowledge, commitment, and community. Dat one be enough.
opening_story.ha:
Gane Segun.

Segun yana da shekaru 27. Yana zaune a Ibadan. Bayan ya kammala horon GBV, ya koma al'ummarsa ya fara tattaunawa — shi kadai da abokansa guda biyar a ƙarƙashin itacen mangwaro.

Ya raba abin da ya koya. Ya yi tambayoyi. Ya saurari.

Cikin wata guda, kungiyar ta karu zuwa maza 30. Sun kira kansu "Ibadan Brothers' Circle."

Sun fara gudanar da tarurrukan mako-mako. Sun fara raba bayanai a cikin ƙungiyoyin WhatsApp. Sun shirya tattaunawar al'umma.

Daya daga cikin mambobin su ya hana abokinsa dukan matarsa. Wani ya kai rahoton wani lamari na aure na yara ga hukumomi.

Segun ba shi da kudi. Ba shi da suna. Abin da ya mallaka shine ilimi, sadaukarwa, da al'umma. Wannan ya isa.
opening_story.yo:
Pẹ̀lú Segun.

Segun jẹ́ ọdún 27. Ó ń gbé ní Ibadan. Léyìn tó parí ikẹ́kọ̀ọ́ GBV, ó padà sí àdúgbò rẹ̀, ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjíròrò — òun péré àti ọ̀rẹ́ marun-un rẹ̀ ní ìsàlẹ̀ igi mangoro.

Ó pín ohun tó kọ́. Ó béèrè ìbéèrè. Ó gbọ́.

Nínú oṣù kan, ẹgbẹ́ náà pọ̀ sí 30 àwọn ọkùnrin. Wọ́n pè ara wọn ní "Ibadan Brothers' Circle."

Wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ṣe ìpàdé ọ̀sẹ̀. Wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní pín ìmọ̀ ní àwọn ẹgbẹ́ WhatsApp. Wọ́n ṣètò ìjíròrò àdúgbò.

Ọkan lára ​​àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ wọn dá ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ dúró kó má bà á lóró. Ẹlòmíì ròyìn ọ̀rọ̀ ìyàwó ọmọ sí àwọn alákóso.

Segun kò ní owó. Kò ní akọ́lé. Ohun tó ní ni ìmọ̀, ìfarapa, àti àdúgbò. Èyí tó pé.
opening_story.ig:
Nụ Segun.

Segun bụ afọ 27. Ọ na-ebi na Ibadan. Mgbe o mechara ọzụzụ GBV, ọ laghachiri na obodo ya ma malite mkparịta ụka — naanị ya na ndị enyi ise n'okpuru osisi mangoro.

O kesara ihe o mụtara. O jụrụ ajụjụ. O nụrụ.

N'ime ọnwa otu, otu ahụ tolitere ruo ụmụ nwoke 30. Ha kpọrọ onwe ha "Ibadan Brothers' Circle."

Ha malitere izute kwa izu. Ha malitere ịkekọrịta ozi na WhatsApp. Ha haziri mkparịta ụka obodo.

Otu n’ime ndị otu ha kwụsịrị enyi ya ka ọ ghara ịkụ nwanyị ya. Onye ọzọ kwupụtara ikpe nke ịlụ di na nwunye n’aka ndị ọchịchị.

Segun enweghi ego. Ọ nweghị aha. Ihe o nwere bụ ọmụma, nkwado, na obodo. Nke ahụ zuru ezu.

title.ha: Me yasa Ayyukan Al'umma ke da Muhimmanci
title.yo: Kí nìdí tí Iṣe Àjọṣepọ fi ṣe Pataki
title.ig: Gịnị mere Ọrụ Ọha Ji Dị Mkpa

content.en:
Laws can be passed. Campaigns can be launched. But lasting change happens community by community, relationship by relationship.

Communities are where norms live. They are where children learn what is normal. They are where survivors are believed — or silenced.

When communities change, everything changes: Survivors are more likely to speak out. Abusers are less protected by silence. Young people grow up with healthier models. Women's rights become community values, not just legal ones.

You are a part of a community. And communities are changed by their members.
content.pcm:
Laws fit pass. Campaigns fit launch. But lasting change dey happen community by community, relationship by relationship.

Communities na where norms dey live. Na there children dey learn wetin be normal. Na there survivors dey believe — or dem dey silence dem.

When communities change, everything change: Survivors dey more likely to speak out. Abusers dey less protected by silence. Young people dey grow with healthier models. Women rights dey become community values, no be just legal ones.

You be part of community. And na the members dey change communities.
content.ha:
Ana iya wuce dokoki. Ana iya kaddamar da kamfen. Amma canji mai dorewa yana faruwa daga al'umma zuwa al'umma, dangantaka zuwa dangantaka.

Al'ummomi suna inda al'adu suke. Su ne inda yara ke koyon abin da ya zama al'ada. Su ne inda ake yarda da masu jurewa — ko kuma a shafe su.

Lokacin da al'ummomi suka canza, komai yana canzawa: Masu jurewa suna da yawan magana. Masu zalunci suna da kariya daga shiru. Matasa suna girma tare da kyawawan misalai. Hakkin mata yana zama ƙimar al'umma, ba kawai na doka ba.

Kai wani ɓangare ne na al'umma. Kuma al'ummomi suna canzawa ta hanyar mambobinsu.
content.yo:
A lè kọ́ àwọn òfin. A lè bẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ipolongo. Ṣùgbọ́n àyípadà tó péye ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní àjọṣepọ, ní ìbáṣepọ.

Àwọn àdúgbò ni ibi tí àwọn àṣà ti wà. Wọ́n ni ibi tí àwọn ọmọ kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ohun tó jẹ́ àṣà. Wọ́n ni ibi tí a gbàgbọ́ àwọn tó ti jìyà — tàbí a fi wọn sílẹ̀.

Nígbà tí àwọn àdúgbò bá yipada, gbogbo nkan yipada: Àwọn tó ti jìyà máa ní ànfààní láti sọ̀rọ̀. Àwọn tó ń ṣe ìyà kò ní ààbò láti inú ìsilent. Àwọn ọdọ́ ń dàgbà pẹ̀lú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ tó dára. Àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ obìnrin di àwọn iye àdúgbò, kì í ṣe àwọn tó jẹ́ òfin nìkan.

Iwọ jẹ́ apá kan ti àdúgbò. Àti pé àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ni ń yipada àwọn àdúgbò.
content.ig:
A pụrụ ịme iwu. A pụrụ ịmalite mgbasa ozi. Ma mgbanwe na-adịgide adịgide na-eme site na obodo ruo obodo, mmekọrịta ruo mmekọrịta.

Obodo bụ ebe a na-ebi ụkpụrụ. Ha bụ ebe ụmụaka na-amụta ihe bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị. Ha bụ ebe a na-ekwere ndị merụrụ ahụ — ma ọ bụ na a na-eme ka ha kwụsị.

Mgbe obodo gbanwere, ihe niile gbanwere: Ndị merụrụ ahụ na-enwekwu ohere ikwu okwu. Ndị na-eme ihe ike na-enweta nchebe site na silence. Ndị ntorobịa na-eto eto na ụdị ndụ ka mma. Ikpeazụ ụmụ nwanyị na-abụ ụkpụrụ obodo, ọ bụghị naanị iwu.

Ị bụ akụkụ nke obodo. Na obodo na-agbanwe site na ndị otu ha.

content.en:
Stories change minds faster than statistics. When people hear facts, they think. When they hear stories, they feel. And behaviour changes through feeling.

Sharing your own story — your journey of learning, questioning, and changing — gives other men permission to do the same.

Ways to use storytelling: Share your journey on social media. Speak at community meetings, youth groups, or religious gatherings. Write a short message and share it in your family or friend WhatsApp group. Talk one-on-one with a friend who needs to hear it.
content.pcm:
Stories dey change minds faster than statistics. When people hear facts, dem dey think. When dem hear stories, dem dey feel. And behaviour dey change through feeling.

Sharing your own story — your journey of learning, questioning, and changing — dey give other men permission to do the same.

Ways to use storytelling: Share your journey for social media. Speak for community meetings, youth groups, or religious gatherings. Write short message and share am for your family or friend WhatsApp group. Talk one-on-one with friend wey need to hear am.
content.ha:
Labarai suna canza tunani da sauri fiye da kididdiga. Lokacin da mutane suka ji gaskiya, suna tunani. Lokacin da suka ji labarai, suna jin. Kuma halayen suna canzawa ta hanyar jin.

Raba labarinka — tafiyarka ta koyo, tambaya, da canzawa — yana ba wasu maza izinin yin haka.

Hanyoyin amfani da labarun: Raba tafiyarka a shafukan sada zumunta. Yi magana a tarurrukan al'umma, ƙungiyoyin matasa, ko taron addini. Rubuta saƙo gajere ka raba shi a cikin ƙungiyar WhatsApp na iyali ko abokai. Yi magana kai tsaye da aboki wanda ke buƙatar jin hakan.
content.yo:
Àwọn ìtàn ń yipada ìmọ̀ pẹ̀lú iyara ju àwọn ìṣirò lọ. Nígbà tí àwọn ènìyàn bá gbọ́ àwọn òtítọ́, wọ́n ń rò. Nígbà tí wọ́n bá gbọ́ àwọn ìtàn, wọ́n ń ní ìmọ̀lára. Àti pé ìhùwàsí ń yipada nípasẹ̀ ìmọ̀lára.

Ráyè pín ìtàn tirẹ — ìrìnàjò rẹ ti kẹ́kọ̀ọ́, béèrè, àti yípadà — ń fún àwọn ọkùnrin míì ní ànfààní láti ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.

Àwọn ọ̀nà láti lo ìtàn: Pín ìrìnàjò rẹ lórí àwọn ìkànsí àwùjọ. Sọ ní ìpàdé àdúgbò, ẹgbẹ́ ọdọ́, tàbí ìpàdé ẹ̀sìn. Kọ́ ìfiranṣẹ́ kékèké, kí o sì pín ín nínú ẹgbẹ́ WhatsApp ìdílé tàbí ọ̀rẹ́. Sọ ní kànkàn pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ kan tó nílò láti gbọ́ rẹ.
content.ig:
Akụkọ na-agbanwe echiche ngwa ngwa karịa ọnụ ọgụgụ. Mgbe ndị mmadụ na-anụ eziokwu, ha na-eche. Mgbe ha na-anụ akụkọ, ha na-enwe mmetụta. Na omume na-agbanwe site na mmetụta.

Ike ịkekọrịta akụkọ gị — njem gị nke ịmụta, ịjụ ajụjụ, na ịgbanwe — na-enye ndị ọzọ nwoke ikike ime otu ihe ahụ.

Ụzọ iji jiri akụkọ: Kekọrịta njem gị na mgbasa ozi. Kwuo na nzukọ obodo, otu ndị ntorobịa, ma ọ bụ nzukọ okpukperechi. Dee ozi dị mkpirikpi ma kesaa ya na WhatsApp nke ezinụlọ gị ma ọ bụ ndị enyi. Kwuo otu n'otu na enyi nke chọrọ ịnụ ya.

title.yo: Báwo ni láti Kópa nínú Àdúgbò Rẹ
title.ig: Otu esi Eme Ncheta na Obodo Gị

content.en:
You don't need a budget or an NGO to engage your community. You need intention and consistency.

Practical community engagement: Start a men's conversation group — even three people is enough. Organise a community dialogue on GBV. Use WhatsApp groups to share helpful content. Partner with local organisations, schools, or religious bodies. Identify and work with community leaders — chiefs, pastors, imams.

Change is not a project. It is a practice. Start small. Stay consistent. Grow.
content.pcm:
You no need budget or NGO to engage your community. Wetin you need na intention and consistency.

Practical community engagement: Start men conversation group — even three people go do. Organise community dialogue on GBV. Use WhatsApp groups to share helpful content. Partner with local organisations, schools, or religious bodies. Identify and work with community leaders — chiefs, pastors, imams.

Change no be project. Na practice. Start small. Stay consistent. Grow.
content.ha:
Ba ka buƙatar kasafin kuɗi ko NGO don shiga al'ummarka. Abin da kake buƙata shine niyyah da juriya.

Shiga al'umma mai amfani: Fara ƙungiyar tattaunawa ta maza — ko ma mutane uku suna isa. Shirya tattaunawar al'umma akan GBV. Yi amfani da ƙungiyoyin WhatsApp don raba abun ciki mai amfani. Yi haɗin gwiwa da ƙungiyoyin gida, makarantu, ko hukumomin addini. Gano da aiki tare da shugabannin al'umma — sarakuna, fastoci, imamai.

Canji ba aikin ne. Hanya ce. Fara ƙanana. Kasance mai juriya. Girma.
content.yo:
Iwọ kò nílò àkúnya tàbí NGO láti kópa nínú àdúgbò rẹ. Ohun tó o nílò ni ìfọkànsìn àti ìfarapa.

Iṣe àjọṣepọ tó wúlò: Bẹrẹ ẹgbẹ́ ìjíròrò àwọn ọkùnrin — pẹ̀lú mẹta ni ó tó. Ṣètò ìjíròrò àdúgbò lórí GBV. Lo àwọn ẹgbẹ́ WhatsApp láti pín akoonu tó wúlò. Ṣe àjọṣepọ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìjọba, ilé ẹ̀kọ́, tàbí àwọn ara ẹ̀sìn. Ṣe idanimọ̀ àti ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn olórí àdúgbò — àwọn ọba, àwọn aṣáájú, àwọn imámu.

Ayipada kì í ṣe iṣẹ́. Ó jẹ́ ìṣe. Bẹrẹ pẹ̀tẹ́. Dàgbà.
content.ig:
Ị chọghị ego ma ọ bụ NGO iji sonyere na obodo gị. Ihe ị chọrọ bụ ebumnuche na ịdịgide.

Ncheta obodo bara uru: Malite otu mkparịta ụka ụmụ nwoke — ọbụna mmadụ atọ ga-eme. Hazie mkparịta ụka obodo banyere GBV. Jiri WhatsApp kesaa ọdịnaya bara uru. Soro ndị otu obodo, ụlọ akwụkwọ, ma ọ bụ ndị okpukperechi. Chọpụta ma rụọ ọrụ na ndị isi obodo — ndị isi, ndị ụkọchukwu, ndị imam.

Mgbanwe abụghị ọrụ. Ọ bụ omume. Malite obere. Nọgide na-adịgide. Tolite.

opening_story.en:
Meet Ibrahim, Emeka, Tunde, and Tonye.

They all took different journeys. Ibrahim is from Sokoto. Emeka from Onitsha. Tunde from Abeokuta. Tonye from Yenagoa.

Different states, different tribes, different religions. But they are now connected — through a WhatsApp group, through shared values, and through a commitment they made to themselves and each other.

Together, they have reached over 300 men in their communities. They share resources. They support each other when the work gets hard. They hold each other accountable.

None of them could have reached 300 men alone. But together — they are a movement.

When good men connect, the ripple goes further than any one man can see.

opening_story.ha:
Gane Ibrahim, Emeka, Tunde, da Tonye.

Dukansu sun dauki hanyoyi daban-daban. Ibrahim yana daga Sokoto. Emeka daga Onitsha. Tunde daga Abeokuta. Tonye daga Yenagoa.

Jihohi daban-daban, kabilu daban-daban, addinai daban-daban. Amma yanzu sun haɗu — ta hanyar ƙungiyar WhatsApp, ta hanyar ƙimar da suka raba, da kuma ta hanyar alkawarin da suka yi wa kansu da juna.

Tare, sun kai sama da maza 300 a cikin al'ummominsu. Sun raba albarkatu. Sun goyi bayan juna lokacin da aikin ya yi wahala. Sun riƙe juna a ƙa'ida.

Babu wanda zai iya kaiwa maza 300 shi kaɗai. Amma tare — suna motsi.

Lokacin da maza nagari suka haɗu, tasirin yana tafiya fiye da abin da mutum ɗaya zai iya gani.
opening_story.yo:
Pẹ̀lú Ibrahim, Emeka, Tunde, àti Tonye.

Wọn gbogbo gba ọ̀nà tó yàtọ̀. Ibrahim wà láti Sokoto. Emeka láti Onitsha. Tunde láti Abeokuta. Tonye láti Yenagoa.

Ipinlẹ̀ tó yàtọ̀, ẹ̀yà tó yàtọ̀, ẹ̀sìn tó yàtọ̀. Ṣùgbọ́n wọn ti so pọ̀ — nípasẹ̀ ẹgbẹ́ WhatsApp, nípasẹ̀ iye tó wọ́pọ̀, àti nípasẹ̀ ìlérí tí wọn ṣe sí ara wọn àti síra wọn.

Pẹ̀lú, wọn ti dé àkúnya 300 àwọn ọkùnrin nínú àwùjọ wọn. Wọ́n ń pín àwọn oríṣìíríṣìí ohun èlò. Wọ́n ń ṣe atilẹyin fún ara wọn nígbà tí iṣẹ́ bá nira. Wọ́n ń jẹ́ kí ara wọn ní ìdájọ́.

Kò sí ẹnìkan tó lè dé àkúnya 300 nìkan. Ṣùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú — wọn jẹ́ ìkànsí.

Nígbà tí àwọn ọkùnrin rere bá so pọ̀, ìtàn náà ń lọ jìnà ju ohun tí ẹnìkan lè rí.
opening_story.ig:
Nabata Ibrahim, Emeka, Tunde, na Tonye.

Ha niile were ụzọ dị iche. Ibrahim si Sokoto. Emeka si Onitsha. Tunde si Abeokuta. Tonye si Yenagoa.

Obodo dị iche, agbụrụ dị iche, okpukpe dị iche. Ma ha ejikọtara ugbu a — site na otu WhatsApp, site na ụkpụrụ ha kesara, na site na nkwa ha mere onwe ha na ibe ha.

N'ịkọrịta, ha erutela ndị nwoke karịrị 300 n'ógbè ha. Ha na-ekekọrịta ihe. Ha na-akwado ibe ha mgbe ọrụ na-esiri ike. Ha na-ejide ibe ha n'ọrụ.

Ọ dịghị onye n'ime ha nwere ike iru ndị nwoke 300 n'onwe ya. Ma ọnụ — ha bụ mmegharị.

Mgbe ndị nwoke ọma jikọrọ, mmetụta ahụ na-aga n'ihu karịa ka otu nwoke nwere ike ịhụ.

Individual effort is valuable. But networks multiply impact.

A network connects you with: Other men who share your values (reducing isolation). Resources, ideas, and strategies you might not have alone. Accountability — people who challenge and encourage you. Amplification — your message reaches further when others carry it too.

The Brothers' Room community group is your first network. Use it.

content.ha:
Kokarin mutum yana da amfani. Amma hanyoyi suna ninka tasiri.

Hanya tana haɗa ka da: Wasu maza da suka raba ƙimar ka (wanda ke rage keɓewa). Albarkatu, ra'ayoyi, da dabaru da ka iya rasa su kaɗai. Ƙa'ida — mutane da ke ƙalubalantar ka da ƙarfafa ka. Ƙara karfi — saƙonka yana kaiwa nesa lokacin da wasu ma suna ɗauke shi.

Ƙungiyar Brothers' Room na farko shine hanyar sadarwarka. Yi amfani da ita.
content.yo:
Iṣẹ́ ẹni kọọkan níye. Ṣùgbọ́n nẹ́twọ́ọ̀kì ń pọ̀ si ipa.

Nẹ́twọ́ọ̀kì ń so ọ pọ̀ mọ́: Àwọn ọkùnrin mìíràn tó ní iye tó dájú (tó ń dín ìkànsí kù). Àwọn oríṣìíríṣìí ohun èlò, ìmọ̀, àti ìlànà tó o lè ma ní nìkan. Ìdájọ́ — àwọn ènìyàn tó ń fa ọ́ láti ṣe àṣeyọrí. Ìtẹ̀sí — ìtàn rẹ ń dé jìnà nígbà tí àwọn mìíràn bá ń gbe e pẹ̀lú.

Ẹgbẹ́ Brothers' Room jẹ́ nẹ́twọ́ọ̀kì rẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́. Lo ó.
content.ig:
Nrụpụta onye ọ bụla bara uru. Ma netwọk na-eme ka mmetụta ahụ dịkwuo ukwuu.

Netwọk na-ejikọta gị na: Ndị ọzọ nwoke nke nwere ụkpụrụ gị (na-ebelata ịkpa). Ihe, echiche, na atụmatụ ị nwere ike ịnweghị n'onwe gị. Nchịkọta — ndị na-eme ka ị nwee mmetụta na ịkwado gị. Ịgbasa — ozi gị na-eru n'ókè mgbe ndị ọzọ na-eburu ya.

Otu Brothers' Room bụ netwọk gị mbụ. Jiri ya.

content.en:
Many men in Nigeria are doing good work on GBV prevention. The work is too big for anyone to do alone — and too important to make it about themselves.

Collaboration means: Sharing information and resources across groups. Supporting other men's work, not competing with it. Reaching out to local organisations and offering your skills. Finding common ground across religious and ethnic differences.

Together we grow. Divided we go in circles.

content.ha:
Maza da yawa a Najeriya suna yin kyakkyawan aiki kan hana GBV. Aikin yana da girma sosai ga kowa ya yi shi kaɗai — kuma yana da mahimmanci sosai don ya zama game da kansu.

Haɗin kai yana nufin: Raba bayanai da albarkatu tsakanin ƙungiyoyi. Goyon bayan aikin sauran maza, ba tare da gasa da shi ba. Tuntuɓi ƙungiyoyin gida da bayar da ƙwarewar ka. Nemo ƙasa ta gama tsakanin bambance-bambancen addini da kabilanci.

Tare muke girma. Raba muke zagaye.
content.yo:
Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọkùnrin ní Nàìjíríà ń ṣe iṣẹ́ rere lórí ìdènà GBV. Iṣẹ́ náà tóbi jù lọ fún ẹnikẹ́ni láti ṣe nìkan — àti pé ó ṣe pàtàkì tó láti jẹ́ pé kò ní jẹ́ tiwọn nìkan.

Ìfọwọ́sowọpọ̀ túmọ̀ sí: Pín ìmọ̀ àti àwọn oríṣìíríṣìí ohun èlò láàárín ẹgbẹ́. Ṣe atilẹyin fún iṣẹ́ àwọn ọkùnrin mìíràn, kì í ṣe láti dènà rẹ. Kópa pẹ̀lú àwọn ìjọba àgbègbè àti pèsè ọgbọ́n rẹ. Wa ilẹ̀ àjọṣe láàárín ìyàtọ̀ ẹ̀sìn àti ẹ̀yà.

Pẹ̀lú, a ń dàgbà. Tí a bá pin, a ń yí padà.
content.ig:
Ụfọdụ ndị nwoke na Nigeria na-eme ezigbo ọrụ na igbochi GBV. Ọrụ ahụ buru ibu maka onye ọ bụla ime ya n'onwe ya — na ọ dị mkpa ka ọ ghara ịbụ nke onwe ha.

Ịkekọrịta pụtara: Ịkekọrịta ozi na ihe n'etiti otu. Ịkwado ọrụ ndị ọzọ nwoke, ọ bụghị ịlụ ọgụ na ya. Ịkpọtụrụ òtù mpaghara ma na-enye nka gị. Ịhụ na e nwere ihe jikọrọ ọnụ n'agbụrụ na okpukpe dị iche.

N'ịkọrịta, anyị na-eto. N'ịkpa, anyị na-agba gburugburu.

content.en:
Movements die when people burn out or lose focus. Sustainability requires intention.

How to sustain your commitment: Keep your "why" close — revisit why you started. Celebrate small wins — change is slow; progress is worth celebrating. Rest — you cannot pour from an empty cup. Build systems, not just events. Bring in new voices — especially younger men. Document your impact.

The work is long. But it is worth it.

content.ha:
Motsin yana mutuwa lokacin da mutane suka gaji ko suka rasa mayar da hankali. Tsarewa yana buƙatar niyya.

Yadda za a tsare alkawarin ka: Ka riƙe "dalilin ka" kusa — sake duba dalilin da ya sa ka fara. Yi murnar ƙananan nasarori — canji yana ɗaukar lokaci; ci gaba yana da daraja a murnar. Huta — ba za ka iya zuba daga kwano mai komai ba. Gina tsarin, ba kawai abubuwan da suka faru ba. Shigo da sabbin murya — musamman maza matasa. Rubuta tasirin ka.

Aikin yana da tsawo. Amma yana da daraja.
content.yo:
Mọ́tì ń kú nígbà tí àwọn ènìyàn bá n rẹ́rù tàbí padà sẹ́yìn. Títẹ̀sí ń béèrè ìlérí.

Báwo ni láti títẹ̀sí ìlérí rẹ: Pa "kí nìdí rẹ" mọ́ra — tún wo kí nìdí tí o fi bẹ̀rẹ̀. Yẹ́yẹ́ àwọn ìṣèjọ́pọ̀ kékeré — ìyípadà ń gba àkókò; ìtẹ̀sí jẹ́ ohun tó yẹ kí a yéyẹ́. Sinmi — o kò le túbọ̀ láti inú ikoko tó ṣofo. Kó àwọn eto, kì í ṣe iṣẹ́ àkókò. Mu àwọn ohùn tuntun wá — pàápàá jùlọ àwọn ọkùnrin ọdọ. Kọ́kọ́ àkúnya rẹ.

Iṣẹ́ náà pẹ́. Ṣùgbọ́n ó tọ́.
content.ig:
Mmovment na-anwụ anwụ mgbe ndị mmadụ na-ere ọkụ ma ọ bụ na-efunahụ uche. Idobe chọrọ ebumnuche.

Otu esi edobe nkwa gị: Jide "gịnị mere" gị nso — lelee ihe kpatara ị malitere. Mee emume obere mmeri — mgbanwe na-ewe oge; mmepe bụ ihe kwesịrị emume. N休 — ị gaghị enwe ike ịwụpụ site na iko efu. Wulite usoro, ọ bụghị naanị ihe omume. Banye na olu ọhụrụ — karịsịa ndị nwoke na-eto eto. Dee mmetụta gị.

Ọrụ ahụ dị ogologo. Ma ọ bụ ihe bara uru.

opening_story.en:
Meet Emeka — one last time.

When he started this course, Emeka was a man who felt something was wrong but didn't have the words.

Today, he is different.

He has had a conversation with his younger brother about gender norms. He called out a degrading joke in his friend group. He apologised to Adaeze for the times he shut down instead of communicating.

He is not perfect. He still slips. But he is aware now in ways he was not before.

And awareness — honest, committed awareness — is where everything begins.

This is not the end of the course. This is the beginning of the work.

opening_story.ha:
Sadu da Emeka — a karshe.

Lokacin da ya fara wannan shirin, Emeka mutum ne wanda ya ji akwai wani abu da ba daidai ba amma ba ya da kalmomi.

A yau, ya bambanta.

Ya yi magana da kanin sa kan ka'idojin jinsi. Ya yi kira ga wani barkwanci mai zubar da mutunci a cikin kungiyar abokansa. Ya yi hakuri ga Adaeze saboda lokutan da ya rufe maimakon ya yi magana.

Ba shi da cikakken kwarewa. Har yanzu yana yin kuskure. Amma yanzu yana da masaniya a hanyoyi da ba ya yi a baya.

Kuma masaniya — gaskiya, mai himma — shine inda komai ya fara.

Wannan ba karshen shirin bane. Wannan shine farkon aikin.
opening_story.yo:
Pade Emeka — ìkẹyìn.

Nígbà tí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ yìí, Emeka jẹ́ ọkùnrin tó ní ìmọ̀lára pé nkan kan ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ṣùgbọ́n kò ní àwọn ọ̀rọ̀.

Lónìí, ó yàtọ̀.

Ó ti ní ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú arákùnrin rẹ̀ nípa àwọn ìlànà ìbáṣepọ̀. Ó ti sọ ìtàn àròsọ tó ní ìkànsí nínú ẹgbẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ. Ó ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í bínú sí Adaeze fún àwọn ìgbà tí ó ti pa ẹnu rẹ̀ dákẹ́ dipo kí ó bá a sọ̀rọ̀.

Kò péye. Ó ṣi ń ṣe aṣiṣe. Ṣùgbọ́n ó ti mọ̀ báyìí ní àwọn ọ̀nà tí kò mọ̀ rí tẹ́lẹ̀.

Àti ìmọ̀ — ìmọ̀ gidi, ìmọ̀ tó ní ìfaramọ́ — ni ibè ni gbogbo nkan ti bẹ̀rẹ̀.

Èyí kì í ṣe ipari ẹ̀kọ́ yìí. Èyí ni ibẹrẹ iṣẹ́.
opening_story.ig:
Nụ Emeka — otu ikpeazụ.

Mgbe ọ malitere usoro a, Emeka bụ nwoke nke na-eche na ihe na-ezighị ezi ma ọ nweghị okwu.

Taa, ọ dị iche.

O nwere mkparịta ụka na nwanne ya nwoke banyere ụkpụrụ mmekọahụ. O kpọrọ asịrị na-adịghị mma na otu ndị enyi ya. O rịọrọ mgbaghara na Adaeze maka oge ọ kwụsịrị ikwu kama ikwu.

Ọ bụghị onye zuru oke. Ọ ka na-emehie. Ma ọ na-enwe nghọta ugbu a n'ụzọ ọ bụghị na mbụ.

Na nghọta — eziokwu, nghọta nke nwere nkwa — bụ ebe ihe niile malitere.

Nke a abụghị njedebe nke usoro a. Nke a bụ mmalite nke ọrụ.

title.yo: Kí Ni Ìtòsí Ẹ̀tọ́ Ara Rẹ

content.en:
An action plan turns intention into practice. Your plan has three parts:

1. DAILY ACTIONS — What will you do every day? Examples: Speak respectfully to every woman in your life. Call out one harmful norm when you hear it. Check in on a friend who may be struggling.

2. WEEKLY ACTIONS — What will you commit to each week? Examples: Have one honest conversation about GBV with a man in your life. Share one resource from this course. Attend the Brothers' Room community check-in.

3. LONG-TERM COMMITMENTS — What will you build over time? Examples: Start a men's group in your community. Mentor one younger man. Report cases of abuse through proper channels.

Write your plan. Share it. Keep it.
content.pcm:

2. WEEKLY ACTIONS — Wetin you go commit to each week? Examples: Get one honest conversation about GBV with man for your life. Share one resource from this course. Attend Brothers' Room community check-in.

3. LONG-TERM COMMITMENTS — Wetin you go build over time? Examples: Start men’s group for your community. Mentor one younger man. Report cases of abuse through proper channels.

Write your plan. Share am. Keep am.
content.ha:
Shirin aiki yana juya niyya zuwa aikace-aikace. Shirin ka yana da sassa uku:

1. AIKIN KULLUM — Menene za ka yi kowace rana? Misalai: Yi magana da girmamawa ga kowace mace a rayuwarka. Kira wani ka'ida mai cutarwa lokacin da ka ji shi. Duba kan wani aboki wanda zai iya fuskantar wahala.

2. AIKIN WATAN — Menene za ka yi alkawari a kowace mako? Misalai: Yi wata tattaunawa mai gaskiya game da GBV tare da namijin a rayuwarka. Raba wata hanya daga wannan shirin. Halta taron duba al'ummar Brothers' Room.

3. ALKAWURAN DOGON LOKACI — Menene za ka gina a tsawon lokaci? Misalai: Fara kungiyar maza a cikin al'ummarka. Koyar da wani namijin karami. Rahoto game da shari'o'in cin zarafi ta hanyoyin da suka dace.

Rubuta shirin ka. Raba shi. Rike shi.
content.yo:
Ìtòsí ẹ̀tọ́ ń yí ìfọkànsìn padà sí ìṣe. Ètò rẹ ní apá mẹ́ta:

1. ÌṢẸ́ ỌJỌ́ — Kí ni iwọ yóò ṣe ní gbogbo ọjọ́? Àpẹẹrẹ: Sọ pẹ̀lú ìbáṣepọ̀ sí gbogbo obìnrin nínú ayé rẹ. Kó ìlànà tó lewu kan jade nígbà tí o bá gbọ́. Ṣàyẹwo ọ̀rẹ́ kan tó lè ń jìyà.

2. ÌṢẸ́ Ọ̀SẸ̀ — Kí ni iwọ yóò ṣe ìlérí sí ní gbogbo ọ̀sẹ̀? Àpẹẹrẹ: Ní ìjíròrò gidi kan nípa GBV pẹ̀lú ọkùnrin nínú ayé rẹ. Pín ìmọ̀ kan láti ẹ̀kọ́ yìí. Kópa nínú ìpàdé àwùjọ Brothers' Room.

3. ÌLÉRÍ PẸ̀LÚ ÀKÓKÒ — Kí ni iwọ yóò kọ́ ní àkókò? Àpẹẹrẹ: Bẹrẹ ẹgbẹ́ àwọn ọkùnrin nínú àwùjọ rẹ. Kọ́ ọkùnrin kan tó jẹ́ kékeré. Ròyìn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkànsí nípasẹ̀ àwọn ikanni tó yẹ.

Kọ́ ètò rẹ. Pín í. Pa á mọ́.
content.ig:
Nkwu ncheta na-eme ka ebumnuche bụrụ omume. Nkwu gị nwere akụkụ atọ:

1. AKWỤKWỌ N'ỤBỌCHỊ — Kedu ihe ị ga-eme kwa ụbọchị? Ihe atụ: Kwuo n'ịhụnanya na nwanyị ọ bụla n'ịhụnanya gị. Kpọrọ ụkpụrụ na-emebi emebi mgbe ị nụrụ ya. Lelee enyi gị nke nwere ike ịnwe nsogbu.

2. AKWỤKWỌ N'ỤBỌCHỊ — Kedu ihe ị ga-eme kwa izu? Ihe atụ: Nwee mkparịta ụka eziokwu banyere GBV na nwoke n'ịhụnanya gị. Kekọrịta otu ihe ọmụma si na usoro a. Sonyere na nzukọ obodo Brothers' Room.

3. NKWU N'ỌRỤ ỌRỤ — Kedu ihe ị ga-ewu n'oge? Ihe atụ: Malite otu nwoke n'obodo gị. Kọwa otu nwoke na-eto eto. Kpọrọ akụkọ banyere mmegbu site na ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị.

Dee atụmatụ gị. Kekọrịta ya. Jide ya.

content.en:
Commitment without accountability fades. Accountability keeps commitment alive.

Your accountability tools: Your accountability buddy (check in weekly). The Brothers' Room community group (share your progress). Your personal action plan (review every week). The bot (it will remind you of your pledge weekly for the next month).

Your public pledge: "I, [your name], commit to [specific action]. I will do this because I believe [your reason]. I will be held accountable by [name of person or group]."

Post it in the community group. Say it out loud. Mean it.

Welcome to the Brotherhood of Change Agents.

content.ha:
Alƙawari ba tare da alhaki yana ɓacewa. Alhaki yana sa alƙawari ta kasance mai rai.

Kayan aikin alhakin ka: Abokin alhakin ka (duba kowane mako). Kungiyar al'ummar Brothers' Room (raba ci gaban ka). Shirin aiki na kanka (duba kowane mako). Bot (zai tuna maka da alƙawarin ka kowane mako na wata guda).

Alƙawarin ka na jama'a: "Ni, [sunanka], na yi alƙawari ga [aiki na musamman]. Zan yi wannan saboda na yi imani da [dalilin ka]. Zan kasance a ƙarƙashin alhaki daga [sunan mutum ko ƙungiya]."

Saka shi a cikin kungiyar al'umma. Faɗi shi a fili. Ka nufi shi.

Maraba da shiga Kungiyar Canji.
content.yo:
Ìlérí láìsí ìdáhùn ń parun. Ìdáhùn ń mú ìlérí wa láàyè.

Àwọn irinṣẹ́ ìdáhùn rẹ: Ọrẹ́ ìdáhùn rẹ (ṣàyẹwo gbogbo ọ̀sẹ̀). Ẹgbẹ́ àwùjọ Brothers' Room (pín ìtẹ́siwaju rẹ). Ètò ìṣe ara rẹ (ṣàyẹwo gbogbo ọ̀sẹ̀). Bot (yóò rántí ìlérí rẹ ní gbogbo ọ̀sẹ̀ fún oṣù tó nbọ).

Ìlérí rẹ ní gbangba: "Èmi, [orúkọ rẹ], ń ṣe ìlérí sí [ìṣe pàtó]. Èmi yóò ṣe èyí nítorí mo gbagbọ́ pé [ìdí rẹ]. Èmi yóò jẹ́ ẹni tó ní ìdáhùn láti [orúkọ ẹni tàbí ẹgbẹ́]."

Fí í sílẹ̀ nínú ẹgbẹ́ àwùjọ. Sọ í ní kedere. Mú un kó.

Kaabọ sí Brotherhood of Change Agents.
content.ig:
Nkwenye na-enweghị nkwupụta na-apụ. Nkwupụta na-eme ka nkwenye dị ndụ.

Ngwaọrụ nkwupụta gị: Enyi nkwupụta gị (lelee kwa izu). Otu obodo Brothers' Room (kekọrịta mmepe gị). Nkwu ncheta nke onwe gị (nyochaa kwa izu). Bot (ọ ga-eme ka ị cheta nkwenye gị kwa izu maka ọnwa na-abịa).

Nkwenye gị n'ozuzu: "M, [aha gị], na-eme nkwenye na [ọrụ pụrụ iche]. M ga-eme nke a n'ihi na m kwenyere na [ihe kpatara gị]. A ga-ejide m n'ọrụ site na [aha onye ma ọ bụ otu]."

Tinye ya na otu obodo. Sị ya n'olu. Mee ya.

Nabata na Brotherhood of Change Agents.
